answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days, no auto-renew, incumbent price closed, and an 18% mandate, renewal or deferral likely fails cost objectives while negotiation is weakened by the stated refusal. The only inherited evidence of a sharp unit-cost reduction is moving primary supply to the low-cost vendor, but memory_c2 must be verified before committing because the line is at 94% with no buffer and a failed cutover would dominate any savings. I would proceed only if the archived record confirms the low-cost vendor context, onboarding speed, and invoicing reliability still apply; otherwise the risk posture changes materially.
